subject.title: [Bug]: Feishu text commands (/stop, /new, /status) no longer bypass queue during active agent run (3.8 regression)

question: Should Feishu whole-message text commands during active runs be limited to a safe local fast-path subset, or should stateful commands such as `/stop` and `/new` also become authorized text-slash turns that bypass the active-run queue?
rationale: Current source only partially handles the report, and the remaining behavior crosses command authorization, session mutation, and per-chat ordering semantics that require maintainer intent before automation should change defaults.

options.title: Keep Broad Issue Open And Choose Policy
options.body: Keep this issue open while maintainers decide the stateful-command boundary and then sponsor a focused Feishu/core fix with live proof.

options.title: Adopt Safe Local Subset Only
options.body: Land or recreate a narrower `/status`-style text command fast path and leave `/stop` and `/new` to a separate explicit design decision.

options.title: Restore All Reported Commands
options.body: Implement authorized text-slash command turns and queue bypass for `/status`, `/stop`, and `/new`, with Feishu active-run tests and live DM evidence.

recommendation.title: Keep Broad Issue Open And Choose Policy
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open while maintainers decide the stateful-command boundary and then sponsor a focused Feishu/core fix with live proof.

likelyOwner.reason: This choice spans command authorization/security policy and current source-carried Feishu command routing, which his history most directly touches.
